prompts.kit: Use case: stylized-concept. Paint a beautiful professional cozy anime RPG inventory concept sheet, Genshin-like art quality but warmer and rustic, belonging to the supplied approved reference icons and limestone concept. CREAM flat parchment background #ece5d8, very subtle fine gold divider rules, warm upper-left light, warm cream highlights, brown/violet shadows, dark brown tinted edges, limited broad color masses, richly hand-painted chunky rounded objects, clear silhouettes. Materials: wood #9b6f3e, bronze brass, cream cloth, moss olive greens. Bright teal ONLY for magic. Not photorealistic or modern UI. These are approval concepts, not final sprites. Each cell must contain an isolated whole object LARGE with ample blank margins, no overlapping other cells. IMPORTANT do not draw small pixel previews; those will be made by actual downsampling later. Text labels small and clear. No outer title banner. Background flat and clean for crop. Reference images are STYLE references only, not edit targets. Wide sheet 1536x1024, exactly 3 columns x 2 rows of equal 512x512 cells. Row-major SIX cells, each cell left half INVENTORY object and right half same object deployed on small earth patch, labels at bottom. 1 Quill strip: folded grey shed pelt with cream quills tied in it; deployed spread pelt strip with upward quills, safe blunt stylization, catches pouncing beast. 2 Lamp post: portable short wooden stake wax lantern; deployed wooden post lantern casts circular warm amber light onto ground, no teal. 3 Slick patch: squat open green ceramic pot of grey-green frog slick; deployed broad glossy slippery oval smear on stone. 4 Clapper: wooden spring-loaded hinged slap boards, visible curled spring; deployed open wooden boards SNAP with subtle sound motion marks, no bell. 5 Pusher plate: square copper foot plate with strong directional chevron and exposed coil spring; deployed extended spring thrusting wooden pad SIDEWAYS, subtle shove arrow. 6 Salve: low cream pot with honey-olive balm and cloth lid; deployed open pot beside small grey fox companion rising to its feet, companion healing use, no planted trap. Keep inventory half centered at x=25% cell and deploy half x=73%, clear gap.

Row 3: Wax (two matte ivory beeswax blocks, one honeycomb cut face, NOT gold); Glow dust (dark glass vial of luminous teal specks with cork, magic only); Vine rope (coiled thick olive braided vine with one leaf, large central hole); Tusk tip (ONE short curved ivory shed tip with blunt broken base, no blood); Shed pelt (folded soft GREY empty fur sheet with cream edge, NO animal head or paws, shed coat from calmed beast). All goods nonviolent gathered materials. Broad shapes read at 32px.
